question: Can a typed decision capsule separate trusted control state from arbitrary repository content and close the representation failures found by EXP-0014?
hypothesis: A bounded typed capsule containing only enums, identifiers, hashes, provenance summaries and explicit freshness rules can preserve decision-critical distinctions without inlining arbitrary repository text.

conditions.mutationRule: capsule snapshots never authorize mutations; state-changing commands must resync and use existing CAS/lease checks

evidence.conclusion: The typed representation closes all six mechanistic representation failures found by EXP-0014. Behavioral fresh-agent decision accuracy is still unmeasured, so EXP-0015 remains running.
